instrument: Mississippi letter to xAI treating Southaven turbines as temporary, mobile units
summary: Mississippi officials told xAI by letter it could run turbines at 2875 Stanton Road South, Southaven, without an air permit because they were deemed temporary and mobile units.
notes: The regulator-issued bypass. Plaintiffs contend no such exemption applies to units powering a permanent facility.
confidence_note: Letter not read; date and signatory unknown.
